label: Cinematic Grade
blurb: A whole cinematic grade in one effect, so you get a film look without touching wheels and curves: pick a look and dial one Strength. Teal and Orange splits cool shadows against warm skin like a blockbuster; Bleach Bypass is high-contrast and desaturated; Warm Film and Cold Thriller set the mood; Vintage fades the blacks like old stock. Each look sets a filmic contrast S-curve, split-toning of the shadows and highlights, and saturation for you; Contrast, Saturation, Vignette and Grain fine-tune on top.
